info.title: Ledgerline Stock Market API
info.description: Indian company financials, ownership, corporate actions, and market information for your applications. Coverage varies by dataset; unavailable datasets and query variants return HTTP 501. Historical market prices are not included. Basic users can access free endpoints; company-specific requests are limited to RELIANCE, HDFCBANK, BHARTIARTL, ICICIBANK, and SBIN (top five by market capitalization at 2026-10-01 close). Discovery, calendars, and service endpoints remain accessible. Personal and Professional subscribers can access all documented endpoints and companies, subject to source coverage. Only Professional permits commercial use. Send a valid API key. Allowances are 10 requests per minute for Basic, 300 for Personal, and 500 for Professional, shared across all account keys. Paid subscriptions are billed monthly.

x-data-conventions: Company overview and Finance endpoints accept only symbol: the unchanged company URL path from search.
Financial statement amounts: INR rupees; EPS: INR per share.
Overview and peer comparison market capitalization: INR crores.
Profitability ratios: fractions; ownership and peer comparison percentages: percentage points.
Missing source fields: null. Summaries may be rounded or delayed.
Internal company-data/extract values retain amount/baseValue; crore means INR crores. Blank cells may become zero and absent rows may be omitted.
Internal date filters apply to the requested page; follow X-Next-Page for paginated datasets.
X-Request-ID correlates every API response with request logs.
